revision_candidate.target_scope: Undetermined stable GPU UUID/BDF set and power domain. The 10-minute attended/machine values are planning metadata until sampling duration and workload timing are explicitly defined.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Tool/version/backend; stable devices; exact power field/domain/units; instantaneous/average/peak statistic; idle/load fixture; warm-up and sample duration/rate; expected range/tolerance; interactive/export command and raw-evidence method; monitoring overhead, no-clear and safety policy.

revision_candidate.preconditions: Formal source correction and fresh review before installation, workload or monitoring.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Before execution, a revised source row containing the complete device/power-domain/workload/sampling/threshold/evidence contract. Current row produces no valid PASS/FAIL evidence.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: None exists. Future platform specification must define the expected statistic for exact GPUs, domain and workload; upstream tool support alone is not acceptance.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not infer a metric, equate requested/enforced limit with draw, launch a load, change caps/clocks, clear logs, sample only one convenient GPU/time, use screenshots without raw/time/device identity or claim completion.

revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Manual screen observation cannot replace the missing metric and acceptance contract.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No execution/recovery is authorized. Preserve state/logs and do not reuse exploratory data.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Procedure/Criteria remain TBD; any power domain/device/workload/sampling/acceptance ambiguity; tool/backend unsupported; no fresh review.
